# Preliminary classification regression fixtures

The compressed JSON files retain public-report claim excerpts, canonical graphs,
source hashes and frozen policy identity needed to reproduce input-validation
failures. Existing identifiers bind the saved graph, claims and receipts; these
historical fixtures do not confer fresh source authority.

Tests provide explicit synthetic classification responses and offline transports.
The assertions preserve source lineage, graph hashes, bounded context and unknown
source authority. These fixtures do not establish model quality.
